name: Melee_Genome_4
display_help: This power grants the user a stacking Regeneration, Resistance, and Status Protection buff for each enemy within an 8 foot radius.  The effect reaches its maximum strength at 4 enemies.  This power also grants a moderate Regeneration, Resistance, and Status Protection buff regardless of nearby foes.  Equipping this Hybrid power grants a passive boost to Regeneration at all times.
display_short_help: Toggle: Self +Regen,+Res(All), +Status Protection(All) per nearby enemy
